Current RTL:
module counter_02 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input en,
  output [3:0] gray
);

  reg [3:0] cnt;
  reg [3:0] gray_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      cnt <= 4'b0000;
      gray_reg <= 4'b0000;
    end else if (en) begin
      cnt <= cnt + 1;
      gray_reg <= {cnt[3], cnt[3] ^ cnt[2], cnt[2] ^ cnt[1], cnt[1] ^ cnt[0]};
    end
  end

  assign gray = gray_reg;

endmodule
